purpose: Synthetic development only: exercises the frozen v2 (privacy-eval-v2-annotation-2) optional segment states extractionStatus/assessment through the adapted, not-activated local rules candidate. Not blinded validation, not heldout, not legal acceptance.
author: Instinct task agent (candidate constructor). Development material only; the v2 heldout requires a fresh independent author per frozen governance.
readInputs: PROTOCOLO-V2-CONGELADO attachment (frozen contract, not in repo)
guia-anotacion-v2-CONGELADA attachment (frozen guide, not in repo)
eval/privacy/dev.jsonl (entity format reference; DEV4 texts are new material)
excludedInputs: No heldout material read (eval/privacy heldout and eval/privacy-v2 heldout remain sealed). No gold operational flags injected; states are declared synthetic local stimuli on segments, never derived from expectedStatus/blockReason/entities.
authoring: Original Spanish examples authored by the generator; offsets calculated programmatically in JS UTF-16 code units; no astral characters. One blockReason per case; assessment 'failed' unused (reserved by the frozen v2 contract); complete cases carry default states only (no optional fields).

validation.canonicalValidateCases: PASS: validateCases(cases,{protocol: contrato v2 congelado (protocol-v2.json, sha256 d0381fcb), split:'dev'}), 16/16. Bajo protocolo v1 estos casos se rechazan por diseno (campos de estado solo validos en version 2).
validation.realCandidatePath: 16/16 expected status and blockReason via projectPrivacyCase + privacy-candidate-worker (adapted, not activated)
validation.detectionsUnderBlock: 2/2 mixed cases keep detections at exact gold spans (person 52-66, email 67-91)
validation.v1Regression: run-privacy-detector --split dev after adaptation: predictions.json and score.json byte-identical to artifacts/privacy/dev-rules-baseline-v4-2026-11-11
validation.blockingConditionUniqueness: Fail-closed segun contrato v2: cada caso bloqueado mapea a exactamente una razon inequivoca coincidente con su evidencia de estado/provenance; complete sin condiciones y solo estados por defecto; assessment 'failed' reservado y ausente.

limitations: Contenido sintetico inventado; sin datos reales de clientes, validez de registros ni contactabilidad.
Evidencia de desarrollo solamente: no mide fallos de extraccion en produccion, restauracion, enrutado ni seguridad de transporte. No integrado al producto ni evaluado oficialmente.
DEV3 (eval/privacy-development-v3) es anterior al congelamiento y usa un campo 'operational' a nivel caso que no conforma el caseContract v2 congelado; se conserva intacto como material historico.

Hallazgo de compatibilidad conocido: cuatro casos operativos del DEV v1 oficial carecen de los estados que v2 exige; el DEV v1 NO se sobrescribe ni se migra. La seleccion de un DEV versionado para una futura corrida v2 y el manifest-v2 son decisiones de coordinacion pendientes.
